data.content_ref: inline:SHARED MECHANISM: SRC_002 and SRC_005 share the mechanism of causal-fingerprint-based divergence detection, but apply it to different corruption loci. SRC_002 detects divergence in downstream consumer state projections (a consumer read the partial fragment and advanced derived state). SRC_005 detects divergence via side-channel leakage (the partial fragment's residue influences resumed computation). Both share mechanism: the causal fingerprint must encode enough information to detect that the resumption point is causally consistent with the committed log. The isolated problem depends on this shared mechanism because both failure modes require the same fingerprint infrastructure to diagnose. REFUTED IF: the causal fingerprint encodes only event identities and not consumer acknowledgments (SRC_002 countercondition), making the two mechanisms operate on disjoint information and thus not share a common mechanism at all.
